reviews.body: One documentation issue on the standard ADK tool-call path.

review_comments.body:
**[P2] Document when ADK hides MCP tool-call errors**

With the README’s `McpToolset` setup on ADK 1.12.0, Temporal still retries when a server consistently returns `INVALID_PARAMS` from `tools/call`. A local MCP server reproduced this behavior. ADK exhausts its own retries and throws `NoSuchElementException`, losing the original `McpError` and its code. The new test throws `McpError` directly and bypasses ADK’s retry path.

Please limit the non-retryable guarantee to JSON-RPC errors ADK surfaces and document that Temporal’s retry policy still applies when ADK loses the original error, as required by `AGENTS.md`.

**[P2] Classify protocol errors raised by MCP toolset factories**

If a registered toolset factory initializes its MCP session and the server returns `INVALID_PARAMS`, `Toolset.get()` wraps the error in a retryable `ApplicationFailure` that bypasses this classifier. I confirmed that the same server rejection is non-retryable when ADK initializes the session during listing, but retryable when the factory initializes it.

Please apply the same classifier in the factory wrapper and keep transport and startup failures retryable. [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/temporalio/ai-integrations/blob/76b1ba0b104543c1103f69b8f6980ef93d48b44f/AGENTS.md#L84)
